item.title: Florida starts English-only policy for driver’s license testing
item.description: The statewide policy of offering Florida driver’s license tests only in English took effect Friday. It ends years of accommodations for speakers of other languages.

item.description: The affected states include California, Colorado, Illinois, Minnesota and New York.

item.title: Justice Department will allow lawmakers to see unredacted versions of released Epstein files
item.description: To access the files, lawmakers will need to give the Justice Department 24 hours’ notice.

item.description: The Epstein files contained several hundred mentions of the crown princess.

item.title: Gators’ new OC aims to produce offensive fireworks at Florida
item.description: Florida coach Jon Sumrall and offensive coordinator Buster Faulkner's collaboration was years in the making and will be key to future success.

item.title: Heat follow idle trade deadline with blown 22-point lead in loss to Celtics
item.description: The last time these teams met, the Miami Heat coughed up a 19-point lead to the Boston Celtics. This time is was even worse.

item.title: Winderman’s view: Spoelstra steadfast of Heat living in moment, as moment gets uglier
